sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: The broad character identity layer made from ancestry, community, and the player's chosen story details.
When: Use when a player asks what shaped their character before the job.
Not When: Do not treat heritage as a fixed rules bonus unless the sheet or official feature says so.
Answer: Use the exact sheet rules for ancestry/community features; use the rest as story permission and roleplay texture.
Example: Varian's Katari heritage can justify heightened scent in scene-specific per-character clues, while the sheet still controls the actual rule bonuses.
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
